description: This file defines the class SearchProductList, which extends ProductList and includes additional attributes related to category facets for presenting search results in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: SearchProductList
classes.description: A class representing search results for products, with category facets included.

methods.name: getCategoryFacets
methods.description: Returns the list of category facets associated with the search product list.

methods.name: setCategoryFacets
methods.description: Sets the list of category facets for the search product list.
